summary.name: Smol.ai
summary.one_liner: Smol.ai is a team file drive with a chat attached to every folder, built for project handoffs such as podcast recordings, edits and feedback, currently in Mac beta.
use_cases: hand off podcast recordings, edits and thumbnails between team members
keep files and discussion for a project in one place
search transcripts and OCR text across stored files
upload large media files that resume after a connection drop
share stable links to documents and revisions
summary.what_it_does: Smol organizes files into nested folders, and each folder has an ongoing chat, owners and statuses. Users can write documents, review revisions and share stable links. Search covers files, messages and processed content, including transcripts, OCR and file questions with source citations. Uploads are adaptive, using up to 1 to 4 parallel parts, and interrupted uploads can resume after the original file is reselected. The page reports its own local speed tests against Google Drive and Dropbox, but describes them as illustrative and not production benchmarks.
notable: Folder-level chat combined with file storage, owners and statuses
Search with transcripts, OCR and cited answers over stored files
Resumable, adaptive uploads with up to 25 GiB per file configured
Storage priced at cost (R2 storage, zero egress) with planned plans
caveats: Pricing is planned and billing is not yet live; plan prices shown are estimates for a planned model
Mac beta requires Apple Silicon and macOS 12+
Speed claims are founder-run local tests and the page says they do not establish a production advantage over peers
